notes: METHODOLOGY: Step 1 (literal base+offset reconstruction) mostly did not resolve as originally framed. grep across all 302 lis+addi sites that load lbl_802EF0A8 shows the assembler NEVER emits a symbolic 'lbl_802EF0A8+0xNNNN' relocation (verified: zero hits for 'lbl_802EF0A8+' anywhere in build/GC6E01/asm/).
